steps.log: host health route reports version, limits and fence

steps.check: health route reports ok, version and an enabled fence
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/health'); if (!response.ok) return false; const payload = await response.json(); return payload.ok === true && typeof payload.version === 'string' && payload.version.length > 0 && payload.fence === 'on' && payload.limits.maxImageBytes > 0; })()

steps.log: list never exposes the absolute home path and token data says where it came from

steps.check: list payload hides the home directory
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/list'); const payload = await response.json(); return payload.folder.startsWith('~') && payload.folder.includes('backgrounds') && payload.images.length >= 1; })()

steps.check: token total reports its data source
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/token-total'); const payload = await response.json(); return typeof payload.total === 'number' && typeof payload.source === 'string'; })()

steps.log: image responses carry security headers and SVG is sandboxed

steps.check: image responses carry nosniff, CORP and private cache headers
SVG response carries a sandboxing CSP
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/files/probe.svg'); const policy = response.headers.get('content-security-policy') || ''; return response.ok && response.headers.get('content-type') === 'image/svg+xml' && policy.includes('sandbox') && policy.includes("default-src 'none'"); })()

steps.log: a same-origin top-level SVG navigation must not execute script

steps.check: sandboxed SVG document did not run its script
